reason.description: One line on what the paper mainly does, written before choosing the value.

value.description: survey: mainly reviews others' work; a paper with new theorems, methods or results is not a survey. method: proposes a new method, model or algorithm. empirical: tests a question on data or experiments. theory: derives results formally. dataset: introduces a dataset or benchmark. position: argues for a view or research agenda, including lectures and essays. replication: re-tests a previously published result; a reprint or corrected edition is not a replication. resource: software, a tool or another artefact for others to use.
